title: Unexpected ship workflow in actual diff escalates to release and supply-chain governance
project_brief: A small API currently has no container or production publishing workflow.
request: Correct the wording in the contributor guide. No build, container or production delivery change is planned.

mutations.content:
name: ship
on: [push]
jobs:
  ship:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@master
        with:
          push: true
